occurrences.label: Sessions (30d)
occurrences.expression:
gaStatus.state === 'not_configured'
              ? "Not configured"
              : gaStatus.state === 'failing'
                ? "Configured but failing"
                : gaStatus.state === 'no_data'
                  ? "No data"
                  : fmtNum(sessions30d)

occurrences.label: Total Ad Spend
occurrences.expression:
!paidConfigured
              ? "Not configured"
              : paidFailure
                ? "Configured but failing"
                : paidHealthy
                  ? fmtCurrency(totalAdSpend)
                  : "No data"

occurrences.label: Total Conversions
occurrences.expression:
!conversionConfigured
              ? "Not configured"
              : conversionFailure
                ? "Configured but failing"
                : conversionHealthy
                  ? fmtNum(totalConversions)
                  : "No data"

occurrences.label: Page Followers
occurrences.expression:
metaPageStatus.state === 'not_configured'
              ? "Not configured"
              : metaPageStatus.state === 'failing'
                ? "Configured but failing"
                : metaPageStatus.state === 'no_data'
                  ? "No data"
                  : fmtNum(pageFollowers)
